name: agent_client_translator
_description: Agente Traductor de Decisiones del Cliente (B72-fase-D.2). Convierte un texto natural del cliente (email/chat/transcripcion de reunion) en una decision formal estructurada con tipo, impacto economico, impacto plazo y deteccion de contradicciones con decisiones previas. Anti scope-creep: cada decision queda registrada inmutable en client_decisions con timestamp + metodo_confirmacion para evitar 'pero yo nunca dije eso' en obra.

parameters.query: SELECT id, name, project_type, location_city, property_area_m2, budget_target, current_phase FROM projects WHERE id = $1::uuid LIMIT 1
SELECT id, summary, client_needs, constraints, status FROM briefings WHERE project_id = $1::uuid ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, decision_tipo, decision_descripcion, impacto_economico, impacto_plazo_dias, fecha_decision, confirmada_cliente FROM client_decisions WHERE project_id = $1::uuid ORDER BY fecha_decision DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT id, version, total_estimated, budget_target, deviation_status FROM cost_estimates WHERE project_id = $1::uuid ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
INSERT INTO agent_executions (project_id, agent_name, status, started_at, input, metadata) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_client_translator', 'running', now(), $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb) RETURNING id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Build Prompt').first().json.project_id, JSON.stringify({ project_id: $('Build Prompt').first().json.project_id, client_text_len: $('Build Prompt').first().json.client_text.length, metodo_confirmacion: $('Build Prompt').first().json.metodo_confirmacion }), JSON.stringify({ request_id: $('Build Prompt').first().json.request_id, source: 'api_client_translator' })] }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO client_decisions (project_id, tenant_id, decision_tipo, decision_descripcion, contexto_propuesta, impacto_economico, impacto_plazo_dias, contradicciones, confirmada_cliente, metodo_confirmacion, evidencia_url)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::text, $4::text, $5::jsonb, $6::numeric, $7::int, $8::jsonb, false, $9::text, $10::text)
RETURNING id, fecha_decision
UPDATE agent_executions SET status = 'completed', finished_at = now(), output = $2::jsonb, metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || $3::jsonb WHERE id = $1::uuid
